description:
Dunloe is a beautifully presented four-bedroom family home offering spacious and thoughtfully arranged accommodation. This instantly appealing home enjoys a wonderful 77ft (23.5) west-facing rear garden in a peaceful cul-de-sac setting just off Killiney Road. Inside, Dunloe has been thoughtfully designed with stylish and tasteful interiors throughout, creating a warm, contemporary home that is both elegant and comfortable. The generous extension to the rear has transformed the living space, creating an impressive open-plan kitchen dining room that forms the true heart of the home.

Designed with family life firmly in mind, this wonderful space provides an inviting setting for everyday living, relaxed family gatherings and entertaining. Large, glazed doors connect the interior seamlessly with the west-facing rear garden, bringing an abundance of natural light into the home and creating an effortless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

The accommodation opens into a welcoming reception hall, finished with attractive walnut-effect timber flooring and complemented by a digital security alarm system and convenient understairs storage. To the front, the stylish sitting room provides a comfortable and inviting retreat, with open fireplace, a particularly versatile addition to the home is the former garage, which has been cleverly transformed into a bright and practical family room. 

The impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and family room extends across the rear of the property, creating a generous and beautifully appointed space with feature island, bespoke painted Shaker-style cabinetry, Flovil range cooker, integrated appliances with smoke mirror splashback and separate pantry. Double folding glazed doors open directly onto the rear patio and gardens, flooding the room with natural light while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. Up stairs are four double bedrooms one with ensuite shower room and family bathroom completes the accommodation. 

The large rear garden is mainly laid out in lawn and is particularly attractive, having been beautifully landscaped and thoughtfully planted including hydrangeas, ferns and rose trees. Bordered by a fence and a wall the garden extends to approximately 77ft (23.5m) in length. The garden is further enhanced by a generous sandstone terrace, providing an elegant space for al fresco dining, entertaining. To the front, a gated gravelled driveway provides off street parking and is further enhanced by an EV charging point and external socket.

There is an abundance of amenities close by to include Killiney Hill, Killiney Golf Club, Dun Laoghaire seafront and the Forty Foot bathing area. Killiney Grove is sure to appeal to families who are looking to get a foothold in the area because of its proximity to excellent primary and secondary schools including Killiney/Glenageary National School, St. Joseph of Cluny, Loreto Abbey Dalkey, Rathdown and Holy Child Killiney. It is well served by public transport being within walking distance of Glenageary DART Station, and the 59 bus route.
